card.name: Negating or qualifying words in lab text
card.fires_on: Small qualifying or negating words such as non, without, no, unbound and excess, placed before a noun in technical product or lab-test descriptions. Also fires on a few other words like human or cell in ingredient lists.

modes.label: Negation or exclusion words
modes.description: Words like non, without, no, unbound that negate or exclude something in lab methods or composition.
